contract_delta_scope: Only the C03 normalization source/derived-node seam. Other Pass0280 requirements, seven records, oracle and scientific limits remain binding.

node_replacement.reason: The reciprocal scale is derived, not decoded from the generic target-vertex row.

operation_signatures.INVERTIBLE_NORMALIZATION: Existing value, scale, inverse signature; verify scale*inverse=1
operation_signatures.NORMALIZATION_MONOMIAL: Product of decoded gauge symbols and declared Wilson symbol; no coefficient literals
operation_signatures.NORMALIZATION_RECIPROCAL: Exact reciprocal of the derived reference scalar
operation_signatures.NORMALIZATION_REFERENCE_SCALAR: Exact quotient prefactor/monomial; reject zero, residual symbols and nonrational values

reference_policy.changes_in_current_action_charges: Do not implicitly change p_ref. Either propagate the changed raw value at the fixed reference, or fail another source-consistency gate.
reference_policy.common_kernel: Coefficient after division by the scalar part of the explicitly source-recorded common prefactor; not the directly action-normalized full-graph coefficient.
reference_policy.domain: p_ref is a nonzero exact rational; extracted expression has no other free symbols
reference_policy.explicit_reference_change: Requires a separately bound changed-source/reference identity; correlated raw/reference changes may legitimately leave K unchanged.
reference_policy.loop_measure: The conventional i/(16*pi^2*epsilon) factor is common to R and K and is not recomputed by this map.
reference_policy.raw_coefficient: Full graph coefficient with the common gauge-coupling monomial and Wilson coefficient factored, before this scalar normalization.
reference_policy.removable_gauge_monomial: Product of the topology coupling_monomial entries
reference_policy.wilson_symbol_role: Declared notation mapping for the source insertion, not a numerical target
